model.expr: (group by (server) (max_over_time(up{job="alloy"}[1h])) unless on (server) group by (server) (max_over_time(up{job="alloy"}[2m]))) or on (server) (0 * group by (server) (max_over_time(up{job="alloy"}[2m])))

annotations.action: On the monitored server, check `docker ps` and the Alloy logs; on the central server, check the ingress access log for 401/403 from this agent.
annotations.cause: The Alloy container on the monitored server stopped, lost its route to the central server, or its credentials were rejected.
annotations.description: No metrics have arrived from this server for over 2 minutes; logs from it are probably missing too.

annotations.action: Check Alloy writer metrics and Loki availability. Correlate affected intervals with Nginx access files and Loki events.
annotations.cause: The receiver may be unavailable or rejecting writes beyond the writer retry window.
annotations.description: The Alloy Loki writer reported dropped entries during the last five minutes.
annotations.summary: Alloy dropped log entries before Loki ingestion

annotations.action: Check Alloy health, file source positions, and the logs network.
annotations.cause: Alloy is stopped or its internal metrics endpoint is unreachable.
annotations.description: Log collection health cannot be confirmed while Alloy metrics are not scrapeable.

model.expr: ((up{job="app-health"} == bool 0) and on(server, instance) (max by (server, instance) (up{job="nginx-health"}) == 1))

annotations.action: Check the named app container health and its Nginx upstream.
annotations.cause: The app process is stopped, unhealthy, or its route is broken.
annotations.description: Prometheus cannot scrape the app health endpoint while Nginx remains reachable. No request traffic is required for this signal.
annotations.summary: {{ $labels.app }} on {{ $labels.server }} health endpoint is not responding through Nginx

annotations.action: Compare the Nginx log_format with the expected JSON fields and inspect the collector logs.
annotations.cause: The Nginx access log format no longer matches the format the collector expects.
annotations.description: The log collector (exporter or Alloy agent) reported malformed access log entries during the last five minutes.
annotations.summary: Access log parse errors detected for {{ $labels.app }} on {{ $labels.server }}

annotations.action: Restore the exporter and check its logs. Compare Loki events with Prometheus counters to assess the known non-backfill gap.
annotations.cause: The exporter is stopped, cannot read the access logs, or is unreachable on the metrics network.
annotations.description: Prometheus cannot scrape the log exporter. Requests during this outage may remain in Loki without being backfilled into Prometheus counters.

model.expr: ((sum by (server, app) (increase(nginx_http_response_count_total{status=~"5.."}[1m])) or on (server, app) (0 * nginx_observability_http_5xx_critical_min_requests)) / clamp_min((sum by (server, app) (increase(nginx_http_response_count_total[1m])) or on (server, app) (0 * nginx_observability_http_5xx_critical_min_requests)), 1) > bool on (server, app) nginx_observability_http_5xx_critical_ratio) * on (server, app) ((sum by (server, app) (increase(nginx_http_response_count_total[1m])) or on (server, app) (0 * nginx_observability_http_5xx_critical_min_requests)) >= bool on (server, app) nginx_observability_http_5xx_critical_min_requests)

annotations.action: Check the app health endpoint, Nginx upstream status, and recent error responses.
annotations.cause: The application is likely experiencing a sustained failure.
annotations.description: The 5xx share exceeded the per-app critical limit with at least the configured minimum request volume over one minute.

model.expr: ((sum by (server, app) (increase(nginx_http_response_count_total{status=~"5.."}[1m])) or on (server, app) (0 * nginx_observability_http_5xx_warning_min_requests)) / clamp_min((sum by (server, app) (increase(nginx_http_response_count_total[1m])) or on (server, app) (0 * nginx_observability_http_5xx_warning_min_requests)), 1) > bool on (server, app) nginx_observability_http_5xx_warning_ratio) * on (server, app) ((sum by (server, app) (increase(nginx_http_response_count_total[1m])) or on (server, app) (0 * nginx_observability_http_5xx_warning_min_requests)) >= bool on (server, app) nginx_observability_http_5xx_warning_min_requests)

annotations.action: Compare application logs and Recent requests for the affected app before escalating.
annotations.cause: The application or an upstream dependency may be failing.
annotations.description: The 5xx share exceeded the per-app warning limit and the minimum request volume over one minute.
annotations.summary: HTTP 5xx ratio is elevated for {{ $labels.app }} on {{ $labels.server }}

model.expr: ((histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (server, app, le) (rate(nginx_http_response_time_seconds_hist_bucket[1m]))) or on (server, app) (0 * nginx_observability_http_p95_critical_seconds)) > bool on (server, app) nginx_observability_http_p95_critical_seconds) * on (server, app) ((sum by (server, app) (increase(nginx_http_response_count_total[1m])) or on (server, app) (0 * nginx_observability_http_latency_min_requests)) >= bool on (server, app) nginx_observability_http_latency_min_requests)

annotations.action: Check for slow upstream operations and compare recent request latency in Loki.
annotations.cause: The app is severely delayed or a dependency is degraded.
annotations.description: P95 latency exceeded the configurable per-app critical threshold with sufficient recent request volume.
annotations.summary: Critical HTTP P95 latency for {{ $labels.app }} on {{ $labels.server }}

model.expr: ((histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (server, app, le) (rate(nginx_http_response_time_seconds_hist_bucket[1m]))) or on (server, app) (0 * nginx_observability_http_p95_warning_seconds)) > bool on (server, app) nginx_observability_http_p95_warning_seconds) * on (server, app) ((sum by (server, app) (increase(nginx_http_response_count_total[1m])) or on (server, app) (0 * nginx_observability_http_latency_min_requests)) >= bool on (server, app) nginx_observability_http_latency_min_requests)

annotations.action: Inspect the Application Detail latency panels and slowest request events in Loki.
annotations.cause: The application, Nginx upstream, or a dependency may be slow.
annotations.description: P95 latency exceeded the configurable per-app warning threshold with sufficient recent request volume.
annotations.summary: HTTP P95 latency is elevated for {{ $labels.app }} on {{ $labels.server }}

annotations.action: Inspect Loki logs and Docker volume capacity; this lab has no reliable filesystem free-space metric.
annotations.cause: The Loki volume may be full or the filesystem may be returning write errors.
annotations.description: Loki reported WAL disk-full failures or failed chunk flushes during the last five minutes.
annotations.summary: Loki reported ingestion or chunk flush failures

annotations.action: Check Loki health, its filesystem volume, and logs-network connectivity.
annotations.cause: Loki is stopped or unreachable from the internal monitoring network.
annotations.description: Loki availability cannot be confirmed from its metrics endpoint.

annotations.action: Check Nginx container health, host-access networking, and the /nginx-metrics route.
annotations.cause: Nginx is stopped, unreachable, or its internal health route is misconfigured.
annotations.description: The Nginx metrics endpoint cannot be scraped.

annotations.action: Inspect the Prometheus logs and /api/v1/status/config before reloading again.
annotations.cause: A scrape, rule, or Prometheus configuration file is invalid.
annotations.description: Prometheus is running, but its most recent configuration reload failed.

rules.title: Prometheus TSDB blocks near retention limit (critical)

annotations.action: Review metric growth and free space; do not assume Prometheus will protect the Docker host filesystem.
annotations.cause: The configured TSDB retention size is nearly saturated.
annotations.description: This signal covers persisted TSDB blocks only; it is not a filesystem-capacity alert.
annotations.summary: Prometheus TSDB blocks exceed 90% of the configured retention size

rules.title: Prometheus TSDB blocks near retention limit

annotations.action: Review cardinality, retention settings, and free space on the Docker data disk.
annotations.cause: Metric volume or retention duration is using most of the configured TSDB block budget.
annotations.description: This signal covers persisted TSDB blocks only; WAL, head data, and filesystem free space are not included.
annotations.summary: Prometheus TSDB blocks exceed 80% of the configured retention size
